application: Encrypted GitHub relay to be built as soon as the private repository is attached; in the meantime, batches prepared in the background (Bash run_in_background) and sending interleaved.
controle: Review: any delegation of a task that needs no judgment to an agent is flagged (dashboard, to be automated)
preuve: Exchanges of 2026-10-16; network test: OneDrive and Google Drive blocked, GitHub reachable from the cloud workspace.
regle: A fully deterministic task (backup, packaging, checksum verification, conversions) runs as a background script, with a resume log, without an agent or attention. For a transfer to the PC, prefer a relay that works on its own (private GitHub repository, encrypted data; or a synchronised file service) to one-by-one calls; an agent is justified only for judgement.
source: The user's message (2026-10-16): "this kind of task does not need a sub-agent, it can be programmed deterministically and run in the background server-side without any attention being needed"; then "google drive and onedrive have existed since well before artificial intelligence" and "Github is an excellent idea".
titre: Deterministic task: a background script, not an agent
